description: Intent i024 (SNAPSHOT=s06, BRANCH=fixed-epidx-rest) complete. Two high-confidence findings reported, both with exact source evidence. (1) s06:drivers/usb/atm/ueagle-atm.c:2206-2212 — uea_boot fills the interrupt URB with 'usb_fill_int_urb(sc->urb_int, sc->usb_dev, usb_rcvintpipe(sc->usb_dev, UEA_INTR_PIPE), intr, size, uea_intr, sc, sc->usb_dev->actconfig->interface[0]->altsetting[0]. endpoint[0].desc.bInterval)' and usb_submit_urb's it at plug-in; grep proves ZERO bNumEndpoints occurrences in the entire file and uea_bind's only guard is ifnum != UEA_INTR_IFACE_NO (0), so the device-declared endpoint[0] of altsetting[0] is read without any endpoint-count validation — the exact site fact f002 flagged unresolved, now classified: OOB read past a short endpoint flex-array or NULL-deref for a 0-endpoint altsetting, with the leaked bInterval installed as kernel URB state. The interface[0]/altsetting[0] levels are structurally in-bounds, isolating the endpoint-index violation. (2) s06:drivers/isdn/gigaset/usb-gigaset.c:706-748 — gigaset_probe takes '&hostif->endpoint[0].desc' (line 708) and '&hostif->endpoint[1].desc' (line 727) with grep proving zero bNumEndpoints occurrences in ALL of drivers/isdn/gigaset/; probe checks bInterfaceNumber/bAlternateSetting/bInterfaceClass but never the endpoint count. endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize (710) sizes ucs->bulk_out_buffer kmalloc (713) and sets bulk_out_epnum; endpoint[1].desc.wMaxPacketSize (737) sizes ucs->rcvbuf kmalloc (739) and usb_fill_int_urb (742-746) programs usb_rcvintpipe(udev, usb_endpoint_num(endpoint)) and endpoint->bInterval from the unvalidated descriptor before usb_submit_urb (748). Both match the seed's untrusted-descriptor-count vs assumed-index invariant in non-media, non-net USB consumers. Bounded negative evidence and residual limitations: the rest of the fixed-epidx-rest sweep (usb/serial, usb/class, usb/misc, usb/storage, sound/usb, HID/input, staging USB trees in s06) was NOT completed this session and remains bounded unexamined search space; no compilation or gadget reproducer was run, so both findings are static source hypotheses; exact fault mode (NULL-deref vs adjacent-heap OOB read) depends on usbcore's num_ep>0 allocation gate; gigaset/ueagle triggering requires a physically attacker-controlled gadget spoofing the drivers' matched vendor/product IDs with a shrunken endpoint array.
